fields.placeholder: As soon as we have it

tools.subjectTemplate: One detail needed to confirm your {{appointmentType}}
tools.bodyTemplate:
Hi {{recipient}},

We are almost ready to confirm your {{appointmentType}}, but we still need {{missingDetail}}.

{{whyNeeded}}. Once we have it, we can confirm {{confirmationTiming}}.

Best,
guidance: Ask for one detail only if that is enough to move forward.
Explain why the detail matters in one short phrase.
Set the confirmation timing clearly.
pitfalls: Do not turn a simple intake message into a long questionnaire.
Do not leave the recipient guessing whether the appointment is still pending.

examples.label: Salon intake
examples.input: appointmentType: color appointment; missingDetail: please share a current hair photo; whyNeeded: so we can choose the right service length; confirmationTiming: right after you send it

We are almost ready to confirm your color appointment, but we still need please share a current hair photo.

so we can choose the right service length. Once we have it, we can confirm right after you send it.

Best,

faqs.q: Should I explain privacy here?
faqs.a: Only if the missing detail is sensitive and your process requires it.

faqs.q: What if I need multiple details?
faqs.a: Request the minimum set that is actually required to confirm.

tools.name: Guest Thank You With Return Invite
tools.audience: Hospitality teams and local operators
tools.outcome: Thank the guest or customer and leave the door open for another visit or booking.
tools.metaDescription: Create a guest thank-you email that acknowledges the stay or visit and invites a future return. Free private email tool by ReplyMind.
tools.h1: Thank them in a way that invites a return.
tools.intro: A thank-you note can strengthen the relationship if it feels specific to the stay or visit. This tool helps you mention what they enjoyed, thank them sincerely, and offer a reason to come back.

fields.placeholder: The view and the easy check-in

fields.label: Return invite
fields.placeholder: We would love to host you again

fields.label: Future help note
fields.placeholder: Reply if we can help with a future booking

tools.subjectTemplate: Thank you for staying with us
tools.bodyTemplate:
Hi {{recipient}},

Thank you again for {{visitOrStay}}. I’m glad you enjoyed {{highlight}}.

{{returnInvite}}. {{futureHelp}} if we can help with anything else.

Best,
guidance: Mention a real part of the experience to keep the note personal.
Keep the return invite warm and simple.
Avoid making the thank-you feel transactional.
pitfalls: Do not sound like you are asking for another booking immediately.
Do not use generic praise that could apply to anyone.

faqs.q: Should I include a discount?
